text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. I feel closer to you than ever 
before...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Little by little... much more than 
before... I can feel... the wind you cut 
through as you run...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Surely this, too... is all thanks to her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best... even more, together 
with that person.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So... wait for me. Just beyond the dim 
twilight――――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll catch up to you one day. I swear it.
